scope: The extant Shaul HaMelech museum campus, including the main Paulson building, its immediate attached ranges, the northern relation member and the named Herta and Paul Amir Building.

references.caption: מוזאון תל אביב לאומנות
categories: Tel Aviv Museum of Art, Main Building

originalReview.notes: Shows the main south entry, large pale stone gallery cantilever, dark recessed glazing, sloping glass roof, overlying concrete volumes and narrow stair-service tower.

quallaSearch.notes: The Qualla original matches the named original Hebrew Wikipedia upload and its public-domain grant. Other selected art is unrelated to the exterior, including an Eretz Israel Museum photo of a different institution. The 2011 Amir Building is represented with mapped controls and the architect and operator’s written descriptions of its folded polished concrete. Attribution-conditioned photographs were excluded.
